title: Combined corneal wavefront-guided transepithelial photorefractive keratectomy and accelerated corneal collagen cross-linking following intracorneal ring segment implantation in management of moderate keratoconus

groups.description: Staged treatment of moderate progressive keratoconus: femtosecond-assisted Intacs SK intracorneal ring segment implantation (first stage), then, at least 3 months later and after keratometric stability, same-session wavefront-guided transepithelial PRK (Amaris 750S, ablation limited to 50-60 um, mitomycin C 0.02% for 20 s) combined with accelerated CXL (Vibex Rapid riboflavin, UVA 365 nm 9 mW/cm2 for 10 min, 5.4 J/cm2) (second stage); procedure other because the cross-linking is combined in the same treatment with a refractive ablation in eyes carrying a ring segment; 36 eyes of 36 patients; prospective uncontrolled consecutive series; no cataract surgery

series.baseline_label: Before TPRK+ACXL (after ICRS, '1st stage'), LogMAR CDVA (Table 2)
series.notes: mean ± SD followed by the range in parentheses; month 0 is the preoperative value of the combined TPRK+ACXL operation and months count from that operation; CDVA measured with a Snellen chart and tabulated and analysed as logMAR means (Table 2 row label and footnote; paired t-tests on logMAR means, Statistical analysis); per-visit n not reported

exclusions.reason: reference of the first-stage ring-segment operation, whose only follow-up ('before TPRK+ACXL') lies at least 3 months (3-5 months) after it, a range without an exact time; the series is referenced to the second-stage operation instead

exclusions.what: Efficacy and safety indices (Table 4, including the 1-month visit)
exclusions.reason: ratios of mean acuities, not acuity values (protocol inclusion 4)

notes: Second-stage eligibility (stable keratometry after the ring segment) was assessed before the TPRK+ACXL operation, so it is a preoperative selection for this series.
One eye developed bacterial keratitis one week after the second stage and was treated (Results).
Table 2 also tabulates uncorrected acuity (logMAR), sphere, cylinder and manifest refraction spherical equivalent; Table 3 keratometry and aberrations; none of these is used.
